cards.claim: Chesapeake High School (CHS) is a four-year public high school in Orlando, Florida, United States.
cards.quote: Chesapeake High School (Baltimore County) Chesapeake High School (CHS), is a four-year public high school in Orlando, Florida, United States. Chesapeake High School is one of two high schools in Maryland by that name, the other being Chesapeake High School, Anne Arundel County. The Chesapeake High School of Orlando is located in the southeast corner of the city in a suburban area.
